hooks.text: 先用弱技能卡蓄能再打出强卡，同时围绕Critter的弱点、抗性与元素限制组队。
hooks.excerpt: Build up energy with weaker Skill cards and spend it to play stronger cards. With each Critter having varied stats, abilities, Weakness and Resistances, making a varied team is key.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 击败校园对手后直接与其交换卡牌，重复卡也能不限次数继续换。
hooks.excerpt: Build your deck by swapping with the characters you beat in battle. Got some doubles? Swap as many times as you like and are able, no limits here.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三选地图中可冒险保留未翻牌换钱，胜利套牌则存入永久Master Binder影响后续开局。
hooks.excerpt: Proceed through Challenges by picking one of 3 map cards but if you're feeling brave, unflipped cards award money that can be used to buy Booster Packs. A victory in a Challenge adds the cards in your battle deck to your permanent Master Binder, letting you customise the starting Critter in future runs.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
